editorial.blurb: Don Pez serves craveable fish tacos made with genuine care in a locally owned spot where the food shines when you have time to savor it.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit in person during off-peak hours to avoid the service lag—the cute patio is perfect for lingering with a michelada while you wait, and order the Baja Fish or Baja Shrimp tacos with fresh guac and homemade chips.
